summary: Completed comprehensive E2E testing of Voiladi dating app. Backend: 100% passing (31/31 tests). Frontend: Auth, discover, navigation, likes, chats, profile all working. One blocking issue found in onboarding prompts step.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking 'Add prompt' button and selecting a prompt question from the modal, the modal doesn't close properly or the answer textarea doesn't become accessible. The Continue button remains disabled, blocking new users from completing onboarding.
ui_bugs.reproduction: 1. Complete onboarding steps 1-6. 2. On step 7 (Prompts), click 'Add prompt' button. 3. Select any prompt option from the modal. 4. Modal should close and show answer textarea, but it doesn't. Continue button stays disabled.
